name: Mount Everest
description: Earth's highest mountain above sea level, located in the Mahalangur Himal sub-range of the Himalayas on the China-Nepal border. Known in Nepal as Sagarmatha and in Tibet as Chomolungma.

name: K2
description: The second-highest mountain on Earth, located on the Pakistan-China border in the Karakoram range. Renowned as the 'Savage Mountain' due to the extreme difficulty of ascent and high fatality rate.

name: Kangchenjunga
description: The third-highest mountain in the world, situated along the India-Nepal border in Sikkim. Held sacred by the people of Sikkim.

name: Lhotse
description: The fourth-highest mountain in the world, connected to Everest via the South Col. Its formidable South Face is one of the most prominent steep walls in the world.

name: Makalu
description: The fifth-highest mountain in the world, notable for its isolated four-sided pyramid structure southeast of Mount Everest.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro
description: A dormant stratovolcano in Tanzania and the highest mountain in Africa, as well as the highest single free-standing mountain above sea level in the world.

name: Aconcagua
description: The highest mountain in the Americas, the highest in the Southern and Western Hemispheres, and the highest peak outside of Asia.

name: Denali
first_ascent: 7 June 1913 (Hudson Stuck, Harry Karstens, Walter Harper, Robert Tatum)
description: The highest mountain peak in North America, with a topographic prominence of 6,144 m (third most prominent peak on Earth after Everest and Aconcagua).

name: Mount Elbrus
description: A dormant volcano in the Caucasus Mountains in Southern Russia, recognized as the highest peak in Europe.

name: Mont Blanc
description: The highest mountain in the Alps and Western Europe, rising in a range that stretches along the French-Italian border and reaches into Switzerland.

name: Mount Fuji
first_ascent: 663 AD (Tradition attributes to En no Gyōja)
description: An active stratovolcano southwest of Tokyo, the highest peak in Japan, an iconic cultural and spiritual symbol designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Vinson Massif
description: The highest mountain in Antarctica, located in the Sentinel Range of the Ellsworth Mountains near the Ronne Ice Shelf.

name: Mount Kosciuszko
description: The highest mountain in mainland Australia, located in Kosciuszko National Park in New South Wales, named in honor of Polish military leader Tadeusz Kościuszko.
